verses.1: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD with all your heart, in truth and righteousness.
verses.2: The works of Jehovah are great; they fulfill all their desires.
verses.3: Hod and Hador acted, and their righteousness will always stand.
verses.4: He made for his people a place of refuge and mercy from the Lord.
verses.5: Teref gave his followers a promise that they would remember his covenant forever.
verses.6: His actions told his people that they should give them a share of the land.
verses.7: His actions are true, and his judgments are just. All of his decrees are indeed righteous.
verses.8: They are truly eternal, made from genuine and pure materials.
verses.9: He sent forth a command to his people, a covenant that is holy and eternal.
verses.10: The beginning of wisdom is the fear of Jehovah. Good intelligence is necessary for all their actions; its teachings will always remain true.
